lines.zh: 我跳过这块石头，再跳下一块。
lines.en: I hop over this stone and onto the next.
Nose to the ground, hunting for edible roots.
A feeler taps the stone ahead.

lines.zh: 软软的身体挤过藤蔓缝。
lines.en: Its soft body squeezes between vines.
It slides over moss, leaving a trail.
It hops onto a low rock and looks around.
It stops short at the floating island's edge.

lines.zh: 一小步一小步挪向浆果丛。
lines.en: It inches toward the berry bush.

lines.zh: 我的触手在风里各晃各的。
lines.en: My tentacles each sway a different way.

lines.zh: 浮岛的午后，我摊成一片。
lines.en: In the floating isle's afternoon, I spread out flat.

lines.zh: 一有响动，我就缩进草里。
lines.en: At any noise I shrink into the grass.

lines.zh: 窝在浮空岛的草地上晒太阳。
lines.en: Basking in the grass of a floating island.
It curls itself into a small ball.
A tentacle toys with a leaf.
It stares at the sea of clouds beyond the island.
It slowly chews the last of a berry.

lines.zh: 被自己的气泡吓了一跳。
lines.en: It startles at its own burp.
It flattens out on a warm stone.

lines.zh: 你蹲低些，我这几根触手才敢伸。
lines.en: Crouch lower, and these few tentacles of mine dare reach out.
I lean in and sniff your hand.

lines.zh: 警惕玩家，我这副变异的壳不太听话。
lines.en: Wary of players; this mutated shell does not obey me.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，是想讨点吃的。
lines.en: I follow you hoping for a bite to eat.

lines.zh: 天境里，我比别的虫大一圈。
lines.en: In the Aether I'm a size bigger.

lines.zh: 我触手上的细毛全竖起来。
lines.en: Every hair on my tentacles stands up.

lines.zh: 触角朝你的方向探了探。
躲在叶后，只露出半只眼。
lines.en: It hides behind a leaf, one eye peeking.

lines.zh: 身体软绵绵，跌倒好痛苦。
lines.en: Soft body hurts when I fall.

lines.zh: 食物太稀少，饿得我瘦了。
雷电打过来，吓得我发抖。
被魔法击中，我浑身发痒。
没有东西吃，感觉很痛苦。
天境太冷，冻得我瑟瑟发抖。

lines.en: My tail got stepped on. That hurt!

lines.zh: 你靠近了，我能尝尝你的味道吗？
lines.en: You're near, can I try your taste?

lines.zh: 小心点，我不是那么好对付的。
lines.en: Watch out, I'm not easy to handle.

lines.zh: 这么多食物，够我享用一阵子了。
lines.en: Such a feast, I'll be full for a while.

lines.zh: 这草真香，简直太美味了。
lines.en: This grass smells so good, so delicious.

lines.zh: 我要在这些蘑菇下休息一下。
lines.en: I'll take a rest under these mushrooms.

lines.zh: 我在这里找到了一个藏身之所。
lines.en: I found a hiding place here.

lines.zh: 我用树叶来包裹我的食物。
lines.en: I wrap my food with leaves.

lines.zh: 这里的食物太多了，我吃不完。
lines.en: There's too much food here, I can't eat it all.

lines.zh: 我选择这棵树下的地方。
你口袋里的浆果，我闻到了。
lines.en: I can smell the berries in your pocket.

lines.zh: 别动，我看看你好不好吃。
lines.en: Hold still. I want to see if you taste good.

lines.zh: 这朵蘑菇比你的靴子香。
lines.en: This mushroom smells better than your boots.

lines.zh: 我只要一片叶子，就一片。
lines.en: I only want one leaf. Just one.

lines.zh: 天境的草真甜，你尝过吗？
lines.en: Aether grass is sweet. Have you tried it?
Come closer and I will share half.
I hit you, are you okay?

lines.zh: 我无意中撞到了你，很抱歉。

lines.en: I hit a stone, are you okay?

lines.zh: 你撞到了我，我有点生气。
lines.en: You hit me, I'm a bit mad.
I hit a branch, be careful.
I hit you, I didn't mean to.

lines.zh: 你撞到了我，我被吓到了。
我撞到了你的身体，感觉不错。
lines.en: I hit your body, it feels good.

lines.zh: 我不小心撞到了你，很抱歉。
找到另一半，我感到安心。
lines.en: Finding a mate, I feel secure.

lines.zh: 我找到了我的伴侣，一起生活。
lines.en: I found my mate, to live together.

lines.zh: 与我的伴侣一起，我很快乐。
我和我的伴侣共同生活。
我与我的伴侣，共同成长。
lines.en: With my mate, we grow together.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，我永远不会离开你。
lines.en: My mate, I'll never leave you.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，我们共同生存。
找到我的伴侣，我心满意足。
蠕动着接近，准备啃食浆果。
lines.en: Creeps closer to munch on berries.
Taps the berry gently with its tentacle.
Chews on the mushrooms on the ground.
Puts a leaf in its mouth.
Searches for food among the vines.
Uses its tentacle to pick up a berry.
Chews on the mushrooms on the ground.

lines.zh: 从藤蔓上摘下一颗浆果。
lines.en: Takes a berry from the vine

lines.zh: 触角先抖了一下，我闻到了。
lines.en: My antennae twitch first — I've caught the scent.
Detects danger and runs away quickly.
Locks onto the target, ready to eat.
Too many legs make me run crooked.
Since the mutation, I eat anything.
Lock onto and attack the prey.
Lock onto and eat the prey.

lines.zh: 我嘶得太用力，触手打结了。
lines.en: I hiss so hard my tentacles knot up.
One bite, and you'll taste the mutation.

lines.zh: 变异出来的颚，咬合不太准。
lines.en: My mutated jaws don't bite straight.
My teeth came out mutated, uneven.

lines.zh: 我这一口带着变异的腥味。
lines.en: My bite carries the stink of mutation.

lines.zh: 甲壳撞过去，我自己也翻了。
lines.en: I ram with my shell and flip myself over.

lines.zh: 我这里变异得只剩脾气。
咬下去时，壳缝里渗出酸。
lines.en: When I bite, acid seeps from the seams of my shell.

lines.zh: 我从天境的云缝里掉下来。
lines.en: I drop through a gap in the Aether clouds.

lines.zh: 被魔法击中，我浑身发冷。
